about: The Workbench icons of the Abbaye drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 64x64 icon (abbaye64.png, CC BY 3.0 like the game's graphics). Abbaye-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Abbaye.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Abbaye.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-abbaye, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (graphics, sounds, data).
